name: 3d-art-museum
description: A first-person walk through 40,000 years of art history. You start in a firelit Paleolithic cave, walk out into a domed rotunda, and choose one of six halls — **The Americas, Europe, Africa, the Middle East, Asia**. Each hall moves forward in time as you walk, and the architecture changes with the era: Doric marble for classical Greece, stained glass for the Middle Ages, gilded coffers for the Renaissance, shoji screens for Edo Japan, glazed-brick friezes for Babylon, a white cube for the modern era.
